newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The emir of Qatar said Ras Laffan port was complete and would be ready to export liquified gas by January 1997.
- The Yemen National Investment Company has been set up with a base capital 300 million riyals, the chairman of the board said.
- Bank of New York lends Egypt Air $300 million to buy 10 airplanes -- six Airbus planes and four Boeing planes -- worth $850 million.
- Moroccan treasury office said foreign investments in Morocco reached 1.667 billion dirhams by the end of July 1996.
